name: Blueprint diagram
summary: Diagram-first explainer: nodes and connectors draw on at the spoken word on a visible grid, then the frame holds long enough to read.

forbidden: bounce, elastic or back overshoot on any entrance (R1)
continuous camera drift or looping decorative motion (R3, R4)

frame_checklist: Every node label is readable at phone size without zooming
Each connector appears only after the word that names it is spoken (R2)
No node or label crosses the title-safe box edge (R5)
The frame holds for at least one full read before the next wipe (R3)
No more than one new callout appears per sentence (R6)
